sourceNotes.note: Confirmed Browns will start Deshaun Watson Sunday vs Texans after concussion; Jacobs finger surgery 2-3w possible; Adams hamstring return after Week 12 realistic.

items.text: The Browns will start Deshaun Watson on Sunday against the Texans.
items.why: Named starter after missing time with concussion; preferred over Shedeur Sanders
items.implication: CLE passing game potentially more efficient; run game and RB roles (incl. Dylan Sampson) may stabilize with veteran QB
items.opportunity: Monitor Sampson snap share and targets with Watson at QB
